Name: Lumisteria Child To NPC Like Parent
Author: Lumisteria
Description:
This mod is a content pack for "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4568]Child To NPC[/url]", currently intended to work with the "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5348]Babysitter[/url]" mod. Both mods are currently mandatory, but if more content packs for Child To NPC are released, i'll do my best to add compatibility with those too.

Features :
- Based on "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/405]Toddlers like Parents[/url]" (if you don't use Child to NPC mod, this is the mod to use)
- Auto or custom mod. Auto mod will use assets based on spouse when possible.
- Most supported spouse inspired style have a female and male haircut.
- Lot of options to choose.
- Choose what clothes will be used outdoor.
- Full of cuteness.

Some images are featuring characters from "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4079]DSVO[/url]" mod !
